entities.name: Luca Ivanković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luca Ivanković is a Croatian female basketball player who plays as center. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, she competed for the Croatia women's national basketball team in the women's event. She is 198 cm tall.
